posts.title: The importance of doing nothing
posts.description: I think spending time doing nothing is incredibly important. Well. Maybe not doing "nothing" per-say. But at least, doing something that is repetitive, monotonous, and requires no brainpower. Whatever keeps your body occupied while allowing your mind to wander.
